Housing | Representative Delia Ramirez Skip to main content   Casework, call: (773) 799-8219   or   (630) 520-9494    Legislative comments, call: (202) 225-5701 Housing “Housing is a human right, period. As a housing organizer, I know that a new future for housing is possible: one that is bold, progressive, affordable, sustainable. In Congress, I am organizing and fighting for legislation and investment to realize a progressive vision of affordable, sustainable housing for all, by tenants and for tenants.” Affordable Housing As the former Executive Director of the Center for Changing Lives—a Chicago-based nonprofit that provided essential housing services —Congresswoman Ramirez understands that housing is a human right. As co-lead of the Green New Deal for Public Housing and co-sponsor of the Fair Housing Improvement Act , the Ending Homelessness Act, and the Build Housing with Care Act , Ramirez is advocating for the expansion and rehabilitation of affordable housing units in our nation. Congresswoman Ramirez knows that affordable housing is the cornerstone of healthy, thriving communities. Tenants’ Rights Congresswoman Ramirez maintains that housing justice must always center tenants. In her first year in Congress, she introduced the Tenants’ Right to Organize Act to protect the power of tenants with federal vouchers to organize. As tenant organizations across the nation are changing the housing landscape, Ramirez’s legislation acknowledges that all tenants deserve decent, safe, stable, and sanitary housing. Home Ownership As the daughter of working-class immigrants, Congresswoman Ramirez understands that owning a home is — for many families — a catalyst for building generational wealth. But discriminatory and exclusionary housing policies and an unaffordable and inaccessible housing market have made it far too difficult for many to achieve the dream of homeownership. A co-sponsor of the Original Fair Housing Resolution , the Housing for All Act , and the Housing Crisis Response Act , Congresswoman Ramirez is a champion for policies and programs that give Americans the opportunity to set roots in a place they can call their own. Veterans | Representative Delia Ramirez Skip to main content   Casework, call: (773) 799-8219   or   (630) 520-9494    Legislative comments, call: (202) 225-5701 Veterans “As a member of the Veterans’ Affairs Committee, I hear both about the resilience and perseverance of veterans and about the trauma and the pain they have endured. I’ve seen how critical it is for veterans and the families of veterans to receive the full benefits our nation promised them and that they have earned. I am committed to listening to them and removing the barriers our veterans experience that keep them from a healthy and thriving life.” Supporting the Transition to Civilian Life Congresswoman Ramirez believes that those who have served our country deserve full access to the resources and benefits that will enable them to successfully transition into civilian life including access to education, housing, employment, and benefits. That is why the first bill Ramirez introduced in Congress was H.R. 1767, the Student Veteran Benefit Restoration Act to help defrauded veterans regain access to their benefits. Ramirez is also the sponsor of the Servicemember Student Loan Affordability Act of 2024 . In committee and out, Congresswoman Ramirez is committed to centering Veterans and their experiences and making sure there are effective programs and robust support available to them post-service. Healthcare for Veterans Congresswoman Ramirez is committed to amplifying the voices of veterans in her district and ensuring veterans get access to the benefits promised to them. Whether a veteran elects to receive care from the Veterans Health Administration or through community care—Ramirez believes no veteran should worry about whether they will be able to access high-quality care. Ramirez advocates for systems that effectively serve our country’s veterans and pushes for solutions to address healthcare challenges veterans continue to face. That is why Ramirez co-led the introduction of H.R. 3735, the Expanding Health Care Providers for Veterans Act . Democracy | Representative Delia Ramirez Skip to main content   Casework, call: (773) 799-8219   or   (630) 520-9494    Legislative comments, call: (202) 225-5701 Democracy “The threats to our multiracial, multicultural democracy–dark money in politics, corruption among elected officials and judges, rising authoritarianism, and the attempts to disenfranchise Black, Brown, and low-income voters - concerns me. But I am clear: my neighbors expect me to work on policies to strengthen and protect our democracy.” Voting Rights As a co-sponsor of the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act , the Same Day Registration Act , and the Freedom to Vote Act , Congresswoman Ramirez is a champion for policies that ensure that every American can exercise their right to vote. In the face of extreme efforts to restrict access to the ballot box, suppress the vote, and undermine Americans’ participation in our democracy, the Congresswoman is fighting to reform campaign finance laws, safeguard democracy domestically and abroad, and end discriminatory voting policies to repair, strengthen and protect our multiracial, multicultural democracy. Good Governance, Ethics, and Oversight Congresswoman Ramirez is an advocate for ethics, oversight, and good governance. Ramirez is a Co-Chair of the Task Force on Strengthening Democracy. Representative Ramirez also co-sponsors various bills to cultivate a more inclusive and responsive Government, including the Freedom to Vote Act , the Department of Peacebuilding Act , and the Democracy Restoration Act . Ramirez understands how critical it is to combat the influence of big money in politics and address our country’s legacy of disenfranchisement of Black, Brown, and low-income communities. Education | Representative Delia Ramirez Skip to main content   Casework, call: (773) 799-8219   or   (630) 520-9494    Legislative comments, call: (202) 225-5701 Education “As a product of public education, I believe in the power of education to lift us up and provide us with opportunities to realize our dreams and contribute to our communities. To ensure a free, culturally competent, high quality education is accessible to every child and young person in this country, we must forgive student debt, address the rising cost of college, and fully fund our public schools, including universal early childhood education.” Student Debt Congresswoman Ramirez believes every student in our community should have an accessible, culturally competent, high-quality education, not forced to choose between paying rent, accessing healthcare, eating nutritious meals, and pursuing higher education. Ramirez is clear we must fight to make higher education free and equitably accessible for all. Until that future is realized, Congresswoman Ramirez is committed to continue fighting for student loan debt forgiveness. Representative Ramirez joined 85 of her colleagues in a letter to President Biden, urging him to swiftly deliver on his promise to deliver student debt cancellation to working and middle class families. Childcare / Early Childhood Education Congresswoman Ramirez believes we must resist any and all cuts to early learning programs and invest in child care funding to support families, children, and essential childcare workers. She is a proud supporter of programs like Head Start and a cosponsor of bills like the Child Care Stabilization Act , the Expanding Child Care Access Act of 2024, and Ramirez believes we must ensure affordable, high-quality, and reliable child care and early learning programs are accessible to all families! Funding for Public Education Congresswoman Ramirez believes every community should have the necessary resources to ensure safe, resilient, high-quality schools. Immigration | Representative Delia Ramirez Skip to main content   Casework, call: (773) 799-8219   or   (630) 520-9494    Legislative comments, call: (202) 225-5701 Immigration “I am the proud daughter of Guatemalan immigrants and wife of an incredible Dreamer. Addressing the global crisis of displacement and realizing comprehensive immigration reform is personal to me. I will continue to tirelessly work to strengthen asylum, provide relief to undocumented immigrants and Dreamers, and address the root causes of migration.” Immigration Reform As the proud daughter of Guatemalan immigrants, Congresswoman Ramirez is working to deliver relief for the broader immigrant community, create legal pathways to citizenship, keep families together, and help our communities and local economies thrive. In her first term in Congress, Ramirez has become a leader in comprehensive legislation to address our broken immigration system, including the American Dream and Promise Act, the Immigrant Detained Persons Legal Rights Act , the SHIELD Act , the American Families United Act , and the Destination Reception Assistance Act . Whether through legislative or executive action, Congresswoman Ramirez is advocating for policies that center our shared humanity and honor the values of our nation. Root Causes of Migration Through her work as the Vice- Ranking Member of the Homeland Security Committee and visits to Latin America, Congresswoman Ramirez knows the humanitarian crisis of displacement doesn’t start at the border and advocates for addressing the root causes of global migration. As the co-founder and co-chair of the Congressional Caucus on Global Migration, Congresswoman Ramirez aims to position Congress as an effective ally to global efforts to create a safer, more equitable world where people can build the life they want and deserve at home. Health Care | Representative Delia Ramirez Skip to main content   Casework, call: (773) 799-8219   or   (630) 520-9494    Legislative comments, call: (202) 225-5701 Health Care “In one of the wealthiest nations of the world, no person should have to choose between getting the care they need or staggering medical debt, buying their medication, or paying their mortgage. Health care is a human right, full stop. Congress must ensure everyone in our communities–no matter their zip code, citizenship status, or economic background– get the care they need when they need it.” Medicare for All Congresswoman Ramirez is a longtime champion of expanding access to quality, affordable health care for all people. As a State Representative, she spearheaded the historic expansion of Medicaid, making Illinois the first state to provide Medicaid benefits regardless of immigration status. As a member of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, Congresswoman Ramirez fights for the passage of the Medicare for All Act , Close the Medigap Act , and the Medicare Dental, Vision, and Hearing Benefit Act . While she works towards Medicare for All, Ramirez is fighting to crack down on Medicare privatization, drugs and services price gouging, and corporate greed. Reproductive Rights and Gender Affirming Care Congresswoman Ramirez is a long-time advocate of reproductive rights, gender-affirming care, and access to safe abortions. A member of the Democratic Women’s Caucus and the Pro-Choice Caucus, Ramirez has sponsored legislation ranging from the Women’s Health Protection Act to the Reproductive Health Care Accessibility Act . Ramirez is clear that the fight for reproductive care must center women, transgender people, and gender-nonconforming individuals. Representative Ramirez is committed to protecting bodily autonomy and make of Roe V. Wade the law of the land through legislative fix. Minority Health Health equity continues to be a priority for Congresswoman Ramirez. Jobs and the Economy | Representative Delia Ramirez Skip to main content   Casework, call: (773) 799-8219   or   (630) 520-9494    Legislative comments, call: (202) 225-5701 Jobs and the Economy “As the proud daughter of hard-working immigrant parents who worked long hours at minimum-wage jobs just to put food on our table, a roof over our heads, and keep the lights on, I know that when workers and working families thrive, we all thrive. Know that in me, you will always find someone who stands ready to fight for working families and to protect and support all workers’ right to have fair wages, safe and dignified working conditions, universal health care, and democracy in their workplace.” Good Paying Jobs for Everyone Congresswoman Ramirez believes that when workers thrive, we all thrive. She continues to uplift the working class and laborers, including being a member of the House Congressional Labor Caucus (CLC) and cosponsoring key pro-labor legislation, including the Paycheck Fairness Act , the Raise the Wage Act , Domestic Workers Bill of Rights Act , the Gig Is Up Act , and more. As a member of CLC, Ramirez continues to advocate for workers' rights, protections, and fair, livable wages and increasing access to skilled training programs, like apprenticeships. Economy for Working-Class Families Congresswoman Ramirez believes in an economy where families have access to affordable and high-quality child care and long-term care, where there is paid leave for all, and where working families are not over-burdened by taxation, while mega-corporations fail to pay their fair share. Ramirez recognizes that an economy that works for everyone must ensure that working families wages keep up with rising costs of living and Congress invests in robust resources and tax credits. The Congresswoman cosponsors several important bills that would bring relief to working families, including the Family and Medical Insurance Leave (FAMILY) Act , Caring for All Families Act , and the End Diaper Need Act of 2023 . Peace Building and Security | Representative Delia Ramirez Skip to main content   Casework, call: (773) 799-8219   or   (630) 520-9494    Legislative comments, call: (202) 225-5701 Peace Building and Security “We must recognize how interconnected the safety of our communities is with the safety and security of our neighbors here and abroad. To achieve long-lasting peace, we must address the root causes of crime and violence and envision a future where our shared humanity is centered. We must work on policies of solidarity, cooperation, and diplomacy; policies that honor our collective safety and peace.” Foreign Affairs Congresswoman Ramirez believes America is part of an interconnected global community. As a co-sponsor of the International Human Rights Defense Act , the Global Respect Act , and the GLOBE Act , Ramirez is dedicated to strengthening our partnerships abroad and promoting democracy, diplomacy, justice, and peace. Ramirez participated in the inaugural Pan-American Congress, a gathering of progressive legislators from North, Central, and South America to address the challenges facing the Western Hemisphere, including democracy, the climate crisis, and peacebuilding. Ramirez remains a strong advocate of peace through diplomacy, solidarity, and cooperation. Criminal Justice / Public Safety Congresswoman Ramirez recognizes the importance of reforming our criminal legal system to keep all our communities safe. As a co-sponsor of Ethan’s Law , the Keep Americans Safe Act , and the Break the Cycle of Violence Act , she advocates for gun violence prevention policies that address the root causes of crime and programs that strengthen community violence prevention and interruption. Congresswoman Ramirez believes that building safer neighborhoods requires a new approach that rightsizes the role of policing in communities, expands mental health and social services, and provides youth employment, economic opportunities, and restorative justice programs. As we confront the climate crisis facing our generation, we must intentionally invest in safe, resilient infrastructure for the well-being of our communities, the economic development of our region, and the future of our families.” Climate Congresswoman Ramirez understands that the climate crisis is a current and future threat to healthy and vibrant communities.
